SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_NAME name, FINPROD_ID hidCode, FINPROD_NAME shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_02, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%') OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%'))
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{ finprodMarketId }

SELECT DISTINCT CASH_OUT_NO id, CASH_OUT_NO text FROM INTERF_CREDIT_ITEM_INFO
CASH_OUT_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%')
SELECT REL_CONTRACT_NO cmsContractId, BECIF cmsBecif, CREDIT_TYPE cmsCreditType, CREDIT_CUSTOMER_NO creditCustomerNo FROM INTERF_CREDIT_ITEM_INFO WHERE CASH_OUT_NO = #{cmsId}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND( CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') OR CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE IS_TRUSTER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND( CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') OR CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT CALENDAR_ID id, CALENDAR_NAME text FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO
CALENDAR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') AND

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_TYPE2,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL,A.MANAGER , A2.MANAGER ) manager, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, A.TRUSTEE_ID, A2.TRUSTEE_ID) trusteeId,
A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, A2.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE) capiIncomeFeature,
A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.TERM_DAYS termDays, A.REMARK remark, A.INVEST_ADVISER investAdviser,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, A.ISSUER, A2.ISSUER) issuer, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, C.LOAD_BANK, C2.LOAD_BANK) loadBank, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, C.ASSET_PROVIDER, C2.ASSET_PROVIDER) assetProvider, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, C.ASSET_SOURCE_UNIT, C2.ASSET_SOURCE_UNIT) assetSourceUnit, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, C.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID, C2.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID) actualCreditProvid, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, T.PFLSH, T5.PFLSH) pflsh,
(CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{ TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17, jdbcType = VARCHAR} THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ) parentPlan, (CASE WHEN B.PUR_SPEED = 0 THEN '01' ELSE '02' END) transMode, B.CREDIT_ENHANCE_MEASURE creditEnhanceMeasure, B.FUND_MANGER_NAME fundMangerName, C.CASH_OUT_NO cmsId,
C.BANK_TRUST_CODE bankTrustCode,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, C.ASSET_SOURCE, C2.ASSET_SOURCE) assetSource, A.P_FINPROD_ID pFinprodId,
C.SETTLE_DAYS settleDays, D.TYPE_6 category, D.TYPE_7 type,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, D.TYPE_9, D2.TYPE_9) type9, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, D.TYPE_10, D2.TYPE_10) type10, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, D.TYPE_11, D2.TYPE_11) type11, DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, D.TYPE_12, D2.TYPE_12) type12,
E.BUYOUT_RATE buyoutRate, G.INVEST_RATE investRate, H.REL_CONTRACT_NO cmsContractId, H.BECIF cmsBecif, H.CREDIT_TYPE cmsCreditType, T.HAP_CREDIT_AMT hapCreditAmt, T.CREDIT_FLAG creditFlag,
DECODE(A.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, B.INVEST_NATURE,B2.INVEST_NATURE) investNature,
B.IS_OPEN_EVERYDAY isOpenEveryDay, C.TRIAL_NO, A.CONTRACT_NO, REP_ASSET_DEPT.REP_ASSET_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B,FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT_BUYOUT_RATE E on A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID AND A.VDATE = E.EFF_DATE LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT C ON A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CREDIT_ITEM_INFO H ON C.CASH_OUT_NO = H.CASH_OUT_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT T2.FINPROD_ID,T1.CREDIT_FLAG, T1.PFLSH,T1.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T1.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES T1 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T2 ON T2.SEQNO = T1.CUSTOMER_ID ) T ON (T.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID OR T.CUSTOMER_ID = A.FINPROD_ID) LEFT JOIN (SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID,T3.CREDIT_FLAG, T3.PFLSH,T3.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T3.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES T3 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T4 ON T4.SEQNO = T3.CUSTOMER_ID ) T5 ON (T5.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID OR T5.CUSTOMER_ID = A.FINPROD_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO F ON F.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND F.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = F.CASH_ID AND G.EFF_DATE = A.VDATE
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A2 ON A2.FINPROD_ID = A.P_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D2 ON D2.FINPROD_ID = A2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT C2 ON C2.FINPROD_ID = A2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B2 ON B2.FINPROD_ID = A2.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT REP_ASSET_DEPT on A.FINPROD_ID = REP_ASSET_DEPT.REP_FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT COUNT(FINPROD_MARKET_ID) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{custormerId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE P_FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId}
